title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Home Credit Bank Kazakhstan is looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. You will be responsible for the reliability, scalability, and security of our production infrastructure that serves millions of banking customers.

Responsibilities:
— Design, build, and maintain Kubernetes clusters (EKS) in AWS
— Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Helm charts
— Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
— Implement and maintain monitoring & observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki)
— Incident response, on-call rotation, post-mortem analysis
— Capacity planning and cost optimization for cloud resources
— Security hardening: network policies, secrets management (Vault)

Requirements:
— 3+ years of hands-on DevOps / SRE experience
— Production experience with Kubernetes (deployment, troubleshooting, networking)
— Strong knowledge of Terraform and AWS services (EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM)
— Solid Linux administration skills
— Scripting in Bash and Python
— Experience designing CI/CD pipelines from scratch

Nice to have: experience in fintech/banking, knowledge of compliance frameworks (PCI DSS), service mesh (Istio), GitOps practices.
